items.text: Cobalt moves to a new core banking system Saturday, December 12, 00:00 to Sunday, December 13, 12:00 (Central Time).
The switch to the new system is taking longer than planned. Some functions may stay unavailable for more hours. Cobalt has not said when it will finish.
